title: Question
description: The input of hitld rights: a call the holder is about to make, described by its attributes (design parts 4.2 and 4.4), and, when it goes to a decider, the parts of the stand-alone question. Not a stored file: it becomes a decision item, so it carries no schema_version.

title.description: A short title for the decision item.

classification.description: Default: internal, so nothing the holder did not classify is published.

areas.description: The areas the call touches. Added to: the areas whose paths match `paths`.

paths.description: Paths the call touches, matched against the areas' globs and a precedent's.

triggers.description: The rule bases the holder says hold, each with the reason in a sentence. Some rules are also checked here without the holder's say: a one-way door, spending beyond agent_spend_max, a call that spans areas.

direction.description: True when the call touches strategy, principles or non-goals (a rule's owner_when: direction).

spend_tokens.description: Tokens the call commits beyond an approved appetite, compared with rights.agent_spend_max.

addressed_to.description: A question put to one person, such as a judgement the evidence contradicts, goes to them whatever the rules say.

blocks.description: Items that cannot proceed until it is answered. They get a needs link.
